	Welcome to Bahama Bob’s!

 
	
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 

In The Press

	
	

 
 This Restaurant is Off the Hook and WOW is it Awesome. Wife and I ordered Bahama Bob burger and it was Great. Daughter and Son in law order the Seafood plate and they said it was Awesome and I think they have the Best Frys on the Beach cooked just right and real crispy. Our waiter Kevin was in a Zone was quick with our orders and making sure everything we ok Thank you Kevin for the Great Service. Also the Price is not bad for what you get. And we will be Back

Mike Headley
 This was hands down the best service I received the entire time I was in the area. I went out one day for lunch with my significant other and the hostess, waitress, and fellow customers were all SO friendly. The waitress was quick and charismatic, the hostess was extremely genuine and welcoming, and the fellow customers were quick to offer to take a picture for my significant other and I. It was only fitting for us to come back on our last night here. Again, a different hostess that was also very welcoming and personable, we had the same waitress who remembered us and was over the top with her excellent service! Not to mention the food here was incredible!

Maddy Holden
 Today was our 1st visit to Bahama Bob's and we were not disappointed! The food was delicious and the portions were generous! Our group ordered the house gumbo, shrimp & scallop skewers with sides, fried mushrooms, onion rings and popcorn shrimp. Our server, Skyler, was excellent! She took very good care of us. This place is a little beach side jewel. Very friendly, cozy and very clean. We will definitely be back soon

Sandra Lindsey

	About Us

	

 
	
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 

	
	
	While on a treasure hunt on the coast of Rum Cay, Bahamas, a hurricane nearly sank Bob’s 45ft sailboat, the “Kavu”. With the main sail gone and power dwindling, he made it back to George Town, Bahamas. To celebrate his defeat of near death, Bob partied for 3 days straight! That’s right, 3 days! When he awoke, blurry eyed, Bob stumbled next door to the bar for a Bloody Mary.

                Feeling more like himself again, Bob booked a ride on the Staniel Cay Express. After arriving in Staniel Cay, Bob caught a ride on a sea plane to Bimini. There, he met Captain Chuck Rohr and his all girl crew, becoming friends instantly. They set sail for Key West, making land fall 3 days later. Right after arriving, Bob took off straight for Margaritaville. Several rum drinks later, he ran into Frank and Steve, old friends from Gulf Shores. They convinced him to come back with them to “The other side of paradise”, on West Beach. While hanging out with Frank and Steve, an idea struck them! “We could build a little slice of Island living right here.”

                Thus, we bring you Bahama Bob’s, welcome! The Real Thing! Where you find the very best of everything you come to the beach for in one place. Always remember, the lower the latitude, the better the attitude!

	

	
	
	
	
 

	
	
	

 
 
 
 
 
	
 
 
 
 
	
 
 
 
 
	
 
 
	
	
	
 

	
	
	
	
	
	
 
 
 

	
	
	The very best of everything you come to the beach for!
